data.one_liner: A popup bubble with a pointing arrow for tooltips, popovers, menus and dropdowns.
data.what_it_does: Provides a single widget for creating popups, tooltips, popovers, menus, and dropdowns that point at any widget with an arrow. It handles automatic placement to stay on screen, follows scrolling/resizing anchors, and supports multiple triggers like tap, hover, and programmatic control.
use_when: You need to display tooltips, context menus, popovers, or dropdowns tied to a specific anchor widget.
You require automatic placement and collision detection so popups never go off-screen.
avoid_when: You are building full standalone screens or dialogs that do not relate to an anchor widget.
You need a dedicated state management or navigation solution.
strengths: Automatic placement ensures popups flip and stay within safe areas and out of the keyboard's way.
Supports multiple triggers including tap, hover, long press, and controller-based opening.
weaknesses: Popups opening as routes do not inherit inherited widgets (like Providers or Blocs) placed between the navigator and the popup unless provided again.
data.minimal_example:
ArrowPopup(
  content: const Padding(
    padding: EdgeInsets.all(8),
    child: Text('Saved to your library'),
  ),
  child: const Icon(Icons.info_outline),
)
